blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – The sudden passing of former Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) star Peter June “PJ” Simon could renew discussions on the importance of emergency medical preparedness in sporting events, particularly at the grassroots and recreational levels. Simon, 46, reportedly experienced difficulty breathing while playing in a 40-and-above basketball tournament in Davao City on Friday night, Nov. 20. He collapsed shortly afterward and was rushed to San Pedro Hospital, where attempts to revive him were unsuccessful.
